correctness.rationale: The blade occupation transitions were verified from exact 3-neighbor majorities, including the mixed-pattern spatial return under hub alternation. The four hub-count comparisons give an exhaustive disjoint decision table. Labelled multiplicities count all binary states, and the sharp four-step witness holds for all blade counts at least three. Two separately implemented programs agree on every initial state up to seven blades and on macrostate formulas through sixty blades; the proof rather than those finite tests establishes the all-size claim.

value.rationale: The sharp universal four-step cutoff and full first-entry/cycle/basin population formulas classify a canonical unbounded clustered graph family. The result distinguishes the microscopic two-cycle count, its basin size, and transient-time layers, with exact exponential density asymptotics. These are natural dynamical invariants, not arbitrary finite slices.
